source: Quiz 5 - Sessions 1-6: Model Training, Alignment, and the Agent Harness
question: Why is next-token prediction called self-supervised learning in the notes?

options.text: The model can train without any target or performance objective
options.feedback: Self-supervision still supplies a learning target. The distinction is that the target comes from the data rather than a separate human label for every continuation.

options.text: The model certifies the factual accuracy of its own predictions
options.feedback: Self-supervision describes how targets are obtained. It does not establish the truth of the learned claims.

options.text: A reward model supplies the target from human response rankings
options.feedback: This describes a signal in the classic human-feedback pipeline. The next-token example is self-supervised because the existing text itself supplies the prediction target.

options.text: Existing text supplies the context and prediction target
options.feedback: A passage can supply a context and its next token. This creates a training example without requiring a person to label every continuation.
